title: Setting and Owning the Frame
coreMove: Recognize a frame collision and calmly establish the interpretation before the facts are judged.
sourcePressure: First solution chapter: live pitches are shaped by competing social interpretations, and weak presenters lose by reacting, overexplaining, or accepting the other side's assumptions.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The writer must keep frame control practical and status-aware, not aggressive, theatrical, or dismissive of the other side.

hook: The room decides who you are before you speak
Win the frame or lose the pitch
tryThisNow: Stand taller in your next meeting

exampleSpecs.domain: architect presenting a library renovation concept to preservation trustees
exampleSpecs.audience: a design lead being treated as a vendor who must defend every line item
exampleSpecs.stakes: the trustees reduce the project to cost cuts before hearing the civic-use frame
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: when a trustee calls the design decorative, she pauses, slides the circulation map forward, and names the decision as public access versus storage, not style preference
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a vellum circulation map unrolled under a marble paperweight

exampleSpecs.domain: sports medicine specialist advising a pro cycling team on recovery protocols
exampleSpecs.audience: a clinician facing coaches who frame recovery as softness
exampleSpecs.stakes: riders keep losing late-season power because the staff treats rest as indulgence
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he lets the coach finish the toughness speech, then places the power-output decline chart beside the race calendar and reframes recovery as preserving watts
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a laminated race calendar beside a crankset power report

exampleSpecs.domain: aquaculture feed supplier pitching a new pellet blend to salmon farm operators
exampleSpecs.audience: a supplier whose offer is being framed as a commodity price quote
exampleSpecs.stakes: the farm chooses the cheaper pellet and absorbs slower growth for an entire season
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: when the operator asks only for price per ton, the supplier turns the feed sample tray toward the growth table and asks which number controls harvest week
exampleSpecs.firstImage: three feed pellets lined on a white sample tray

exampleSpecs.domain: airport retail operator defending a local-food concession bid
exampleSpecs.audience: an operator being boxed into rent-per-square-foot comparison
exampleSpecs.stakes: the airport loses a distinctive tenant mix and the operator loses a ten-year lease
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she changes the conversation from rent alone to dwell time by pointing to receipt timestamps from delayed flights
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a strip of airport receipts clipped beside a gate-delay report

exampleSpecs.domain: legal aid director asking county supervisors for eviction-defense funding
exampleSpecs.audience: a nonprofit leader facing a room that frames the request as charity spending
exampleSpecs.stakes: families lose representation while county shelter costs rise
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she marks the point where she accepted the charity frame and writes the replacement frame, avoidable county cost, in the margin
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a yellow legal pad beside a stack of eviction notices

exampleSpecs.domain: premium coffee importer negotiating with a grocery chain buyer
exampleSpecs.audience: an importer whose beans are being compared to discount bulk bags
exampleSpecs.stakes: the chain strips the origin story and forces a price-only listing
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she stops answering the discount comparison and asks whether the buyer wants a commodity shelf or a destination shelf before opening the cupping ledger
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a burlap sample bag beside a stained cupping ledger

skillTargets: spot a frame collision before facts are debated
choose a calm reframing move instead of overexplaining
analyze when a presenter accepted the wrong assumption
evaluate frame control without rewarding disrespect

tryThisNowSpec: Write the sentence the other side might use to define you weakly, then write the calmer frame you want the room to judge instead.
